title: EAS React Components
tagline: This library offers a comprehensive solution for managing attestations and schemas, supporting both user and admin tasks by providing customizable forms, badge components, and tools for creating and revoking attestations, all within a React application.
description: A React-based library for displaying, creating, and managing attestations and schemas. It supports both user and admin use cases that lets users generate, customize, and build forms in layers. Besides the library there is an admin dashboard for badge and schema management, and tools for creating or revoking attestations, generating Farcaster frame to perform attestation and showcase proofs, making it a complete solution for managing attestations and schemas in web applications and Farcaster clients.
how_its_made:
The library is developed using React and Sass, allowing for flexible customization through the use of props. These props enable you to customize each component, with the ability to modify individual elements by their names.
Farcaster frames function as a hosted service, where a unique frame is generated for each schema or attestation. These frames can then be used in any Farcaster client.
